propositions: Below-horizon derived commits and trees must be collapsed to SNAPSHOT-anchored checkpoints using core-git fast-import on a disposable shadow clone without mutating production
Authorship ledger positions (ts-uuid invariants) must be re-resolved to new commit SHAs and identity.enforce_since must be re-anchored to the new baseline for consistent ancestry-era verification

The offline collapse engine must refuse execution unless the target is explicitly marked as a shadow clone, is not the live tracker path, has no push-capable remotes, and carries a copied remote-tracking horizon ref
Reducer state equality must be preserved before and after collapse: all above-horizon history and still-observable ticket state remain bit-identical in reduced form
verify-authorship must validate clean against the rewritten shadow branch with no unverifiable mutating events using the re-anchored enforce_since value
